external_primary_research.structural_lesson: Cache/action reuse is keyed from declared action inputs; overly broad environmental inputs reduce useful reuse, while omitted relevant tools/environment can cause false cache hits. This supports exact dependency scoping plus fail-closed completeness rather than arbitrary broad hashing.
boot_id is stable within a boot and changes across boots, supporting a separate boot-epoch identity rather than folding boot-sensitive state into a single long-lived host identity.
wpctl status reports current PipeWire objects, devices, sinks, sources, filters and streams; this is runtime/session topology and should not be treated as immutable host identity material.
Deterministic outputs are functions of declared inputs; the transferable mechanism is explicit dependency identity, not importing Nix itself.

hypothesis: Keep the whole-profile digest as provenance, but compute requirement-scoped binding digests over explicit field sets so irrelevant fact changes do not force unrelated revalidation while every requirement-relevant change still fails closed.
counterhypothesis: The monolithic digest is operationally preferable because requirement maps can omit real dependencies and silently preserve stale evidence; any scoped binding must prove zero false-preserve cases over a declared dependency universe before promotion.
acceptance_gate: Across controlled mutations, every change to a requirement-declared field must invalidate that requirement binding; unrelated-field changes should preserve the binding. Any missing/unknown dependency-map entry is fail-closed and blocks promotion.
